turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Happy Friday, Sofia! How are things going in Tucson today? Ready for the weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, so ready. It is absolutely scorching in Tucson today. I was very glad to have the AC blasting in my hybrid when I drove into the clinic this morning.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet! That hybrid AC is a lifesaver in July. Did you end up checking out that true-crime podcast your coworker recommended during the drive?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Actually, I skipped the true-crime today. Instead, I put on one of those audio lessons for learning Italian to practice my pronunciation while I was on the road.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Che bello! That's a great way to make use of your commute, especially with your online course. How is the Italian coming along?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's slow but fun! I'm mostly just trying to get the basics down. Speaking of things I made, my lunch today was amazing—I built a sandwich using some of the fresh crusty sourdough I baked the other night.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, yum! There's really nothing better than a sandwich made with homemade sourdough. Have you been doing a lot of baking lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not as much as I'd like, honestly. Between my shifts at the clinic and wedding planning with Tom, my free time has been pretty limited.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is completely understandable. Wedding planning can definitely feel like a second job! How are things shaping up for your Summer 2028 date?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're actually starting to look at some outdoor venue options, though looking at them in this Tucson heat makes me glad we have plenty of time before 2028!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Haha, definitely smart to plan ahead and avoid doing tours in the peak of summer! I hope you and Tom get to relax a bit this weekend.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you! Yes, we're planning a very low-key weekend. I'm just finishing up my shift now and looking forward to heading home.
